summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. Mobile & tablet responsive dashboard overhaul with segmented switcher tabs (Overview, Schedule, Team Chat, Focus) to completely eliminate element collisions and overlapping shown in user screenshot.
2. End-to-end dual-keyed RBAC role persistence (UUID + Email) from client through Express backend and Supabase, preventing role reversion to CLIENT_VIEWER upon reload, with prominent '✓ DB Verified & Synced' visual indicators.
3. Dark Obsidian SaaS Landing Page extreme makeover with high-resolution generated visual assets, interactive product preview sandbox, bento feature grid, and transparent tier pricing.
